title: Plan evidence-anchored parsing verification
body: Build a controlled ground-truth two-column document with known text/order/table, parse it, and compute exact fidelity metrics; then demo on a real open-access paper. No prepared answers.

title: Report honest limits
body: Image-only scanned pages are flagged unreadable (OCR out of scope); table cells use pdfplumber to avoid PyMuPDF glyph reordering. Low scores would be reported as limitations, not patched.
